from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['fit_affine_calibration', 'align_panel_covariates', 'fit_preloaded_creep']


def fit_affine_calibration(commands: np.ndarray, measured_stress: np.ndarray,
                           check_groups: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, *,
                           command_scale: float, stress_scale: float,
                           prior_lines: np.ndarray | None = None,
                           min_span_ratio: float = 0.5) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return physical [gain, bias] lines and independent batch support flags.

    Scales are positive characteristic magnitudes in command and measured stress
    units. Isolated EMI errors are downweighted before screening. A sparse group
    needs a comparable same-group historical line in requested group order;
    its gain is held fixed unless at least two prior-consistent checks span the
    minimum baseline (default: half the command scale). All gates are relative
    to the declared scales. Apply the resulting lines to commanded loads only.
    """
    if not np.isfinite([command_scale, stress_scale, min_span_ratio]).all() or min(command_scale, stress_scale, min_span_ratio) <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Calibration scales and minimum span must be positive and finite.')
    u = np.asarray(commands, float) / command_scale
    v = np.asarray(measured_stress, float) / stress_scale
    cg, gr = np.asarray(check_groups), np.asarray(groups)
    prior = None if prior_lines is None else np.asarray(prior_lines, float)
    if u.ndim != 1 or v.shape != u.shape or cg.shape != u.shape or gr.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError('Expected matching check vectors and a requested group vector.')
    if prior is not None and prior.shape != (gr.size, 2):
        raise ValueError('Expected one prior gain and bias per requested group.')
    physical = np.array([stress_scale / command_scale, stress_scale])

    def line(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        dx = x[i] - x[j]
        keep = np.abs(dx) > np.finfo(float).eps * np.max(np.abs(x))
        gain = np.median((y[i[keep]] - y[j[keep]]) / dx[keep])
        a = np.column_stack((x, np.ones(x.size)))
        b = np.array([gain, np.median(y - gain*x)])
        for _ in range(8):
            r = y - a @ b
            s = max(1e-4, 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))))
            w = 1 / np.hypot(1, r / (2.5*s))
            b = np.linalg.lstsq(a*w[:, None], y*w, rcond=None)[0]
        return b

    lines = np.empty((gr.size, 2))
    supported = np.zeros(gr.size, dtype=bool)
    finite = np.isfinite(u) & np.isfinite(v)
    for k, group in enumerate(gr):
        use = finite & (cg == group)
        x, y = u[use], v[use]
        if x.size >= 4 and np.ptp(x) >= min_span_ratio:
            b = line(x, y)
            r = y - (b[0]*x + b[1])
            s = 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r)))
            ok = np.abs(r) <= max(0.002, 4*min(s, 0.005))
            if ok.sum() >= max(4, x.size//2 + 1) and np.ptp(x[ok]) >= min_span_ratio:
                lines[k] = (b if ok.all() else line(x[ok], y[ok])) * physical
                supported[k] = True
                continue
        if prior is None or not np.isfinite(prior[k]).all():
            raise ValueError(f'Group {group!r} lacks independent support and a historical line.')
        b = prior[k] / physical
        delta = y - (b[0]*x + b[1])
        close = np.abs(delta) <= 0.02
        if close.sum() >= 2 and np.ptp(x[close]) >= min_span_ratio:
            b = line(x[close], y[close])
        elif close.any():
            b[1] += np.median(delta[close])
        elif delta.size >= 2 and np.ptp(delta) <= 0.004:
            b[1] += np.median(delta)
        lines[k] = b * physical
    return lines, supported


def align_panel_covariates(features: np.ndarray, references: np.ndarray,
                           groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned, imputed covariates and original rowwise missingness.

    Features and controls share a positive groupwise affine measurement gauge;
    controls have comparable baseline moments across groups. Take the medians
    of the reference-column means and population SDs using columns with at
    least two finite entries. No scale floor is used. For each feature, average
    the finite-entry means of observed group-stratum cells with support in that
    feature. A wholly absent feature fills to zero. Only covariates and controls
    enter this calculation; include target rows when unlabeled panel use is allowed.
    """
    x = np.asarray(features, float).copy()
    ref = np.asarray(references, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('Features, controls and labels must have matching specimen rows.')
    missing = ~np.isfinite(x)
    x[missing] = np.nan
    levels, gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)
    _, si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)
    gi, si = gi.ravel(), si.ravel()
    for i, group in enumerate(levels):
        use = gi == i
        panel = ref[use]
        panel = panel[:, np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2]
        if not panel.shape[1]:
            raise ValueError(f'Group {group!r} has no supported reference column.')
        panel = np.where(np.isfinite(panel), panel, np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite([center, scale]).all() or scale <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f'Group {group!r} requires a finite center and positive reference spread.')
        x[use] = (x[use] - center) / scale
    total = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    cells = np.zeros(x.shape[1], dtype=int)
    for i, j in np.unique(np.column_stack((gi, si)), axis=0):
        cell = x[(gi == i) & (si == j)]
        n = np.isfinite(cell).sum(axis=0)
        total += np.divide(np.nansum(cell, axis=0), n, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=n > 0)
        cells += n > 0
    fill = np.divide(total, cells, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=cells > 0)
    return np.where(missing, fill, x), missing.any(axis=1)


def fit_preloaded_creep(features: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray,
                       past_stress: np.ndarray, past_durations: np.ndarray,
                       initial_memory: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray,
                       initial_strain: np.ndarray, fit_rows: np.ndarray,
                       observed_strain: np.ndarray, initial_rates: np.ndarray,
                       missing_features: np.ndarray, thresholds: np.ndarray, *,
                       tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], yield_stress: float,
                       secant_stress_floor: float, rate_shrinkage: float = 0.95,
                       rank_rtol: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit a two-mode sub-yield model and predict for every input specimen.

    History is piecewise constant on a shared duration grid. Memory is in stress
    units before the first step, with columns ordered fast then slow. Inputs
    are calibrated stresses and dimensionless, imputed features and strain.
    Rates are strain per time unit; the time scale is the upper tau bound.
    Observed absolute strain curves follow fit_rows order. Initial rates cover
    all rows and must be finite on fit_rows; elsewhere nonfinite means absent.
    Use bounded, separated taus, soft-L1 then Cauchy with separate MAD scales,
    and a relative local-rank test; there is no coefficient ridge. On non-fit
    rows with missing features and a finite rate, add rate_shrinkage (0.95 by
    default) times the initial rate innovation to drift only.

    Return (taus, coefficients, strain, initial rates, secants, crossing times,
    crossing flags). Coefficients are two physical compliances, a drift intercept,
    and drift slopes per feature. Crossing is the first upward threshold hit
    on the piecewise-linear sampled curve starting at time zero; a nonhit is
    censored at the final sample with a false flag. This is not an instantaneous
    failure law and does not detect unobserved between-sample excursions.
    """
    x, h, p, dt, mem, t, e0, y, rates, threshold = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in (
        features, hold_stress, past_stress, past_durations, initial_memory, times,
        initial_strain, observed_strain, initial_rates, thresholds))
    rows = np.asarray(fit_rows)
    missing = np.asarray(missing_features, dtype=bool)
    lo, ts = map(float, tau_bounds)
    ss = yield_stress
    if not np.isfinite([lo, ts, ss, secant_stress_floor, rate_shrinkage, rank_rtol]).all() or not (
        0 < lo < ts and ss > 0 and secant_stress_floor > 0 and 0 <= rate_shrinkage <= 1 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1):
        raise ValueError('Invalid time bounds, stress scales, shrinkage, or rank tolerance.')
    if x.ndim != 2 or dt.ndim != 1 or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size:
        raise ValueError('Expected a feature matrix and shared one-dimensional time grids.')
    n = len(x)
    if any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (h, e0, rates, missing, threshold)) or p.shape != (n, dt.size) or mem.shape != (n, 2):
        raise ValueError('Incompatible specimen and history arrays.')
    if rows.ndim != 1 or rows.dtype.kind not in 'iu' or not rows.size or np.any(rows < 0) or np.any(rows >= n) or y.shape != (rows.size, t.size):
        raise ValueError('Fit indices must be valid and match the observed curve rows.')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (x, h, p, dt, mem, t, e0, y, rates[rows], threshold)):
        raise ValueError('Model inputs and fit observations must be finite.')
    if np.any(dt < 0) or t[0] < 0 or t[-1] <= 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) <= 0) or np.any(np.abs(h) >= ss) or np.any(np.abs(p) >= ss):
        raise ValueError('Require a positive hold horizon, ordered nonnegative times and sub-yield loads.')
    x = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    hn, pn, mn = h/ss, p/ss, mem/ss
    dn, tn = dt/ts, t/ts
    age = np.r_[np.cumsum(dn[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if dn.size else dn
    duration = dn.sum()
    obs = np.r_[(y - e0[rows, None]).ravel(), rates[rows]*ts]
    ncurve, ncoef = y.size, x.shape[1] + 2
    lower = lo/ts
    separation = 1e-6*(1 - lower)

    def design(tau: np.ndarray, xf: np.ndarray, hf: np.ndarray,
               pf: np.ndarray, mf: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, ...]:
        a, b = age[:, None]/tau, dn[:, None]/tau
        decay, jump = np.exp(-a), -np.expm1(-b)
        preload = mf*np.exp(-duration/tau)
        gap = hf[:, None] - pf @ (decay*jump) - preload
        dg = -(pf @ (decay*(a*jump - b*np.exp(-b))/tau)) - preload*duration/tau**2
        q = tn[:, None]/tau
        shape, ds = -np.expm1(-q), -np.exp(-q)*q/tau
        curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :]*shape, xf[:, None, :]*tn[None, :, None]), axis=2)
        rate_basis = np.column_stack((gap/tau, xf))
        return curves, rate_basis, dg[:, None, :]*shape + gap[:, None, :]*ds, (dg - gap/tau)/tau

    def decode(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([v[0], v[0] + separation + (1 - v[0] - separation)*v[1]])

    xf, hf, pf, mf = x[rows], hn[rows], pn[rows], mn[rows]

    def blocks(v: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        c, r, dc, dr = design(decode(v), xf, hf, pf, mf)
        return np.vstack((c.reshape(-1, ncoef), r)), np.vstack((dc.reshape(-1, 2), dr))

    def jacobian(v: np.ndarray, a: np.ndarray, d: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        d = d*v[2:4]
        return np.column_stack((d[:, 0] + (1-v[1])*d[:, 1], (1-v[0]-separation)*d[:, 1], a))

    def scales(residual: np.ndarray, multiplier: float) -> np.ndarray:
        def spread(r: np.ndarray) -> float:
            return max(1e-6, 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))))
        return multiplier*np.r_[np.full(ncurve, spread(residual[:ncurve])), np.full(rows.size, spread(residual[ncurve:]))]

    bounds = ([lower, 0.] + [-np.inf]*ncoef, [1-separation, 1.] + [np.inf]*ncoef)

    def optimize(start: np.ndarray, scale: np.ndarray, loss: str):
        def fun(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            a, _ = blocks(v)
            return (a @ v[2:] - obs)/scale

        def jac(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            a, d = blocks(v)
            return jacobian(v, a, d)/scale[:, None]

        return least_squares(fun, start, jac=jac, bounds=bounds, loss=loss,
                             x_scale='jac', max_nfev=300, ftol=2e-10)

    starts = []
    for f1, f2 in ((0.01, 0.16), (0.03, 0.33), (0.07, 0.49), (0.16, 0.81), (0.35, 0.95)):
        t1, t2 = lower + (1-lower)*np.array([f1, f2])
        v = np.array([t1, (t2-t1-separation)/(1-t1-separation)])
        a, _ = blocks(v)
        starts.append(np.r_[v, np.linalg.lstsq(a, obs, rcond=None)[0]])
    pilot = starts[1]
    a, _ = blocks(pilot)
    scale = scales(a @ pilot[2:] - obs, 2.5)
    candidates = [optimize(start, scale, 'soft_l1') for start in starts]
    coarse = min((r for r in candidates if r.success), key=lambda r: r.cost, default=None)
    if coarse is None:
        raise RuntimeError('No soft-L1 pilot converged.')
    a, _ = blocks(coarse.x)
    scale = scales(a @ coarse.x[2:] - obs, 2.8)
    fit = optimize(coarse.x, scale, 'cauchy')
    if not fit.success:
        raise RuntimeError('Cauchy refinement did not converge.')
    a, d = blocks(fit.x)
    j = jacobian(fit.x, a, d)/(scale*np.hypot(1, fit.fun))[:, None]
    norm = np.linalg.norm(j, axis=0)
    if j.shape[0] < j.shape[1] or np.any(norm == 0):
        raise ValueError('Observations do not identify the fitted parameters locally.')
    singular = np.linalg.svd(j/norm, compute_uv=False)
    if singular[-1] <= rank_rtol*singular[0]:
        raise ValueError('Observations do not identify the fitted parameters locally.')

    tau, beta = decode(fit.x), fit.x[2:]
    c, r, _, _ = design(tau, x, hn, pn, mn)
    base_rate = r @ beta
    correction = np.zeros(n)
    apply = missing & np.isfinite(rates)
    apply[rows] = False
    correction[apply] = rate_shrinkage*(rates[apply]*ts - base_rate[apply])
    delta = c @ beta + correction[:, None]*tn
    strain = e0[:, None] + delta
    secant = delta[:, -1]/np.maximum(np.abs(h), secant_stress_floor)
    grid = np.r_[0., t]
    values = np.column_stack((e0, strain))
    hit = values >= threshold[:, None]
    first = hit.argmax(axis=1)
    crossing = np.where(hit[:, 0], 0., t[-1])
    ix = np.flatnonzero(first > 0)
    k = first[ix]
    left, right = values[ix, k-1], values[ix, k]
    crossing[ix] = grid[k-1] + (grid[k]-grid[k-1])*(threshold[ix]-left)/(right-left)
    coefficients = np.r_[beta[:2]/ss, beta[2:]/ts]
    return tau*ts, coefficients, strain, (base_rate+correction)/ts, secant, crossing, hit.any(axis=1)

def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.r_[np.linspace(-1., 1.5, 6), [-0.5, 0.8]]
    groups = np.repeat([3, 9], [6, 2])
    stress = np.where(groups == 3, 1.12*cmd - 0.03, 0.91*cmd + 0.09)
    stress[[0, 7]] += 0.5
    requested = np.array([3, 9])
    priors = np.array([[np.nan, np.nan], [0.91, 0.08]])
    line, support = fit_affine_calibration(cmd, stress, groups, requested,
                                           command_scale=1., stress_scale=1., prior_lines=priors)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(support, [True, False])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(line, [[1.12, -0.03], [0.91, 0.09]], atol=1e-10)
    factor = np.array([0.01/2, 0.01])
    order = np.arange(cmd.size)[::-1]
    scaled, flags = fit_affine_calibration(2*cmd[order], 0.01*stress[order], groups[order], requested[::-1],
                                          command_scale=2., stress_scale=0.01, prior_lines=priors[::-1]*factor)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(flags[::-1], support)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled[::-1], line*factor, atol=1e-12)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        fit_affine_calibration(cmd, stress, groups, requested, command_scale=1., stress_scale=1.)

    panel = np.array([[-1., 1.], [1., -1.]]*3)
    labels = np.array([3, 3, 3, 3, 9, 9])
    strata = np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0])  # no (9, 1) cell
    features = np.array([[0.], [0.], [0.], [3.], [6.], [np.nan]])
    aligned, missing = align_panel_covariates(features, panel, labels, strata)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(aligned[:, 0], [0, 0, 0, 3, 6, 3])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(missing, [False]*5 + [True])
    gain = np.where(labels == 3, 2., 5.)[:, None]
    bias = np.where(labels == 3, -7., 4.)[:, None]
    perm = np.array([5, 2, 0, 4, 3, 1])
    ax, am = align_panel_covariates((gain*features+bias)[perm], (gain*panel+bias)[perm],
                                    (30-labels)[perm], strata[perm])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(ax, aligned[perm], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(am, missing[perm])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
    n = 24
    x = rng.normal(size=(n, 2))
    h = rng.uniform(-0.8, 0.8, n)
    p = rng.uniform(-0.8, 0.8, (n, 3))
    dt = np.array([0.33, 0.95, 0.51])
    z0 = rng.uniform(-0.6, 0.6, (n, 2))
    x[-3:], h[-3:], p[-3:], z0[-3:] = 0., [0.8, 0.8, 0.1], 0., 0.25
    times = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.08, 8., 16)]
    tau = np.array([0.62, 3.7])
    coef = np.array([0.21, 0.17, 0.009, 0.006, -0.004])
    e0 = rng.normal(scale=0.004, size=n)
    z = z0.copy()
    for k, duration in enumerate(dt):
        survival = np.exp(-duration/tau)
        z = survival*z + (1-survival)*p[:, k, None]
    modes = (h[:, None]-z)*coef[:2]
    drift = coef[2] + x @ coef[3:]
    base = e0[:, None] + modes @ (1-np.exp(-times/tau[:, None])) + drift[:, None]*times
    rate = (modes/tau).sum(axis=1) + drift
    measured = rate.copy()
    measured[-3:] += [0.12, 0.4, 0.0]
    measured[-1] = np.nan
    incomplete = np.zeros(n, bool)
    incomplete[[-3, -1]] = True
    rows = np.arange(n-3)
    predicted = base.copy()
    predicted[-3] += 0.95*0.12*times
    expected_rate = rate.copy()
    expected_rate[-3] += 0.95*0.12
    threshold = np.full(n, 10.)
    threshold[-3] = predicted[-3, 6:8].mean()
    threshold[-2] = e0[-2] - 0.01
    floor = 0.2
    result = fit_preloaded_creep(x, h, p, dt, z0, times, e0, rows, base[rows], measured,
                                  incomplete, threshold, tau_bounds=(0.2, 8.), yield_stress=1.,
                                  secant_stress_floor=floor)
    for value in result:
        assert np.isfinite(value).all()
    np.testing.assert_allclose(result[0], tau, rtol=2e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(result[1], coef, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(result[2], predicted, atol=2e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(result[3], expected_rate, atol=2e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(result[4], (predicted[:, -1]-e0)/np.maximum(np.abs(h), floor), atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(result[5][-3:], [times[6:8].mean(), 0., times[-1]], atol=2e-6)
    assert result[5][0] == times[-1]
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(result[6], [False]*(n-3) + [True, True, False])
    # Change stress units and halve the characteristic time. Reverse the fit
    # sample order as well; nominal fit indices still match their observations.
    ss, ts = 0.01, 0.5
    converted = fit_preloaded_creep(x, ss*h, ss*p, ts*dt, ss*z0, ts*times, e0, rows[::-1],
                                     base[rows[::-1]], measured/ts, incomplete, threshold,
                                     tau_bounds=(0.2*ts, 8.*ts), yield_stress=ss,
                                     secant_stress_floor=ss*floor)
    for actual, expected in zip((converted[0]/ts, converted[1]*np.r_[[ss, ss], [ts]*3],
                                 converted[2], converted[3]*ts, converted[4]*ss, converted[5]/ts), result[:6]):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-7)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(converted[6], result[6])


run_self_test()
